result.topic_en: Printed Latin doctoral diploma of the Göttingen medical faculty, visible only as mirror-image show-through. It confers the degree of Doctor of Medicine, Surgery and Obstetrics on Ioannes Robertus Brandmann after a public dissertation on post-mortem caesarean section; it contains no Riemann mathematics.
